gen-gf-miniver-fs-rowan: Bold Miniver shades its round and straight strokes only moderately, leaving the rounds light and unpinched. But the real strength is the difference: display Miniver up top, Rowan's friendly serif text beneath, good for a few lines.
gen-gf-modern-antiqua-fs-rowan: Modern Antiqua draws its c and s half unwrapped, with thicks that stay mild. Rowan, a friendly text serif whose thin strokes run half its thick ones' weight, is happiest away from long paragraphs.
gen-gf-mogra-fs-paquito: Neon tubing, basically: Mogra draws every stroke like rounded wire. Paquito keeps its capitals close to the x-height, a low, confident text serif that lets Mogra's dominant lowercase do the shouting.
gen-gf-monofett-fs-erode: Barely parted curves and big round lowercase bowls give Monofett its closed-in look. Erode, a dignified serif with broad apertures on g and a, can go a size up without losing its openness.
gen-gf-mynerve-fs-neco: Friendly Mynerve draws hand-drawn round bowls like cut lengths of cord, leaving a gap in every c. Neco, an authoritative serif, swells gently from hairline to stem, so a slightly smaller size would work.
gen-gf-mynerve-fs-rowan: Mynerve keeps a quiet, level beat, its round bowls hand-drawn and a visible gap between the ends of every c. Rowan, the literary serif, can sit a notch larger than you'd think.
gen-gf-mynerve-outfit: Easygoing handwriting, that's Mynerve, with round bowls and a gap in every c. And Outfit, a friendly sans-serif with curves that finish before they close, makes a stretch of reading feel light.
gen-gf-mynerve-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk draws each glyph as a ribbon of constant width. Mynerve does friendliness best, its hand-drawn bowls loose and relaxed, while Space Grotesk does geometric order and open counters best.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-fs-neco: Nanum Gothic Coding bends flat, contrast-free letters from a single length of tubing, wide-mouthed and relaxed. And Neco, a serif of moderate contrast, gives lines an authoritative voice that reads best in brief bursts.
gen-gf-nanum-gothic-coding-fs-recia: Recia reads sharp and authoritative, its modulation faint until you look closely. Nanum Gothic Coding does relaxed, true monoline drawing best, while Recia handles weight variation, however slight, and generous openings.
